slot: Your question, plus the daily report
summary: The S&P 500 rose 1.06 percent to 7,747.71 today, the second straight strong day. The main driver was Fed Governor Christopher Waller, who said he would support holding interest rates steady at the September meeting if inflation keeps easing. That calmed fears of another rate hike and sent bond yields lower, which is good for stocks. Gold surged 3.53 percent and Bitcoin jumped 5.61 percent, both signaling that investors are moving money into assets that do well when the dollar weakens. Friday brings the August jobs report, which is the next big test for this rally.
